texts.name: Greyoak Deep
texts.blurb: Old grey oaks and the dark between them.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every 106 seconds roots close 4 ways and open 4 others. A green glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks. Two wisps are bound in it, and the Grey Oak waits at its heart, far to the north. Free the wisps, cut the roots that feed it, and its door opens.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: The paths move, but my lamps stay put. Mostly.

people.name: The Kiln-Mother
greet: You found the burners’ clearing? Then you can stand by it a while.

people.name: The Charm-Pedlar
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Heart of the Wood
intro: Clear the bark den, and its wisp follows you: lead it to the heart. Then the old stones: the Stag-Crowned guards the second wisp. Last, cut the three roots that feed the Grey Oak, and its door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. The Grey Oak’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the bark den to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the old stones to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the heart
Go to the Grey Oak’s door

quests.name: Old Rootfoot
intro: Old Rootfoot walks round the old oak. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from the old wood. Keep it.

quests.name: The Pale Stag
intro: The Pale Stag walks the far glades. Nobody lights the lamps while it does.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps: one at the spring, one at the lantern shrine. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see the paths move.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the moss.

quests.name: The Lost Bundle
intro: Rowan dropped a bundle in the dark thicket and will not go back for it. Carry it to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.

steps.text: Bring the bundle from the dark thicket to the fire

quests.name: The Burners’ Watch
intro: My stacks lie past the burners’ clearing. Find them, then hold the clearing while I bring the charcoal in: the hounds smell the smoke.
outro: All in, and dry. Take this.

steps.text: Hold the clearing while the charcoal comes in

doors.name: The Grey Oak’s door
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once the Grey Oak has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Cantor. Walk into the thicket behind me and we see who is better. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: The lanterns were hung for travellers.
The roots drink their light now.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

named1.name: Old Rootfoot
named1.blurb: Walks round the old oak and strikes hard.

named2.name: The Pale Stag
named2.blurb: Walks the far glades and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the heart. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: The Grey Oak
ruler.title: Bark like a shield
ruler.line: Cut the roots that feed it; it stands open when none is left
